title: EKS private control plane: Terraform module for cert-safe upgrades & health verification harness
creator: Priya Nair
description: Create a new Terraform module and accompanying verification harness to safely perform control-plane upgrades and certificate rotations for Redwood Private EKS clusters. The module should minimize downtime, preserve API server cert trust chains, and provide prescriptive preflight checks + a canary flow that executes automated health probes before rolling changes to customer fleets.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes inputs for cert rotation window, KMS key ARN, api_server_endpoint_whitelist, and canary namespace configuration
Module supports in-place rotation when possible and a documented safe-path for recreate when unavoidable
Preflight plan validator fails with clear errors for SSH/key/KMS misconfigurations and incompatible CNI versions
Automated verification harness runs: control-plane readiness probe, etcd quorum check, apiserver cert validity check, kubelet client connections smoke test
Canary rollout executes on a single cluster (or dedicated canary plane) and reports pass/fail via Console dashboard link
Documentation and upgrade runbook with rollback steps and tfstate backup instructions are merged
tasks: Draft Terraform module API and arguments
Implement certificate rotation helper that integrates with AWS KMS and preserves cert chain metadata
Add lifecycle rules + create_before_destroy toggles to protect control-plane endpoints
Build preflight validator (terraform validate wrapper + k8s api checks)
Implement a verification harness (bash + go healthprobe) that can run in CI and in customer preflight
Author docs: runbook, example usage, and a migration checklist
Create GitHub PR and solicit design + security review
